title: chrysanthemum ornatum var. tokarense
intro: Chrysanthemum ornatum var. tokarense, commonly known as the Toka chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues and has been found to exhibit several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Toka chrysanthemum include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
